chapter: Family follow-ups from the first reels
title: His mother's age and travelling with the band
summary: His mother was much younger than his father; disapproval of the marriage; a woman travelling with a band needed her husband for protection.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You mentioned that your mother was considerably younger than your father?
My mother was quite a big younger than my father. My mother is 21 years younger than -- she's 21 years older than I am, so subtract that from 1912 and you'll find out what day she was born.
Okay, and so she was very young (inaudible)?
No, they almost ran -- wanted to run my father out of town for marrying the lovely little girl, being one of those bad musicians out on the road.
There probably weren't very many women traveling in bands.
There were hardly no musician women traveling with bands at that time.
Then, if they played an instrument, they played it in church and that was it?
That's right. The only reason she was traveling with my father was the fact that he was her husband and he was there as a protector. Things were kind of rough in those days.
